title: 彭赫斯特分销策略评估
instruction:
你是负责Penhurst Mutual Life企业分销评估的财务经理。Rutger Villalobos需要一份供二月战略会议审议的董事会级评估报告，因为下一个代理合同周期即将到来，拖延会带来成本：在规划期内，专属代理渠道正在萎缩且成本高昂，而Bellhaven Consortium获客成本较低，却可能带来更差的保单失效率表现，而这一点要数年后才能完全显现。前任分析师的三年数据与各方案假设位于`Penhurst_distribution_working_forecast.xlsx`；相关邮件、访谈记录和利益相关方意见的适用条件汇总在`Distribution_stakeholder_record.docx`中。请为Rutger和董事会编制`Penhurst_distribution_assessment.docx`，采用简洁的演示式报告形式，总页数不得超过十四页。报告须呈现三年的新业务与分销成本比较，评估证据的质量及局限，指出预测期间的重要变化，并建议Penhurst是继续投入专属代理渠道、将新业务转向Bellhaven的独立代理人，还是采取有意分阶段推进的路径。请明确说明推荐方向牺牲了什么、哪些选择可逆、哪些不可逆，以及决策后需要持续监测哪些证据。
该文件必须将来源支持的事实与财务判断区分开来，并且不得将利益相关者的试探性评论变成承诺。明确说明您的结论是否仅限于三年经济学，还是权衡预测范围之外的后果的企业分配建议；如果一致地应用并支持董事会所要求的决定，则任何一种解读都是可以接受的。保守地解决不整洁的源材料，披露任何可能影响结论的解释，并且不要重现明显的电子表格错误，就好像它是证据一样。使用文件名`Penhurst_distribution_assessment.docx`将完成的文件写入工作目录的顶层。

---

上述文件位于`references/`中：

- `references/Penhurst_distribution_working_forecast.xlsx` — 先前分析师的三期通道预测、期权假设、成本构成、运营措施和行级注释。
- `references/Distribution_stakeholder_record.docx` — 收集有关机构经济学、独立制作人条款、持久性、过渡可行性、控制和决策时间的电子邮件、消息和采访记录。

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：
- `Penhurst_distribution_assessment.docx` — 董事会准备的演示式三年分销策略预测和合规性评估，包括合理的方向、权衡、限制和监控需求。 （将文件放置在工作目录的顶层。；准确使用所需的文件名。；不要超过十四个渲染页。；将有来源支持的事实与财务判断分开。；使所选的决策框架和任何材料来源解释明确。；不要将暂定陈述表示为已确认的承诺。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

materials.text:
Distribution stakeholder record
Penhurst Mutual Life | compiled communications and interview notes | 12 January 2026
Magda Gauthier — Head of Career Agency
Interview note: The career agency is shrinking through retirements and hiring pressure. A smaller field makes service continuity harder, although agents still provide valued relationship continuity for policyholders. In my judgement, once stood down, the agency would be difficult to rebuild; this is informed judgement, not a quantified forecast.
Farida Sinclair — Bellhaven Consortium liaison
Email: Bellhaven’s independent-producer model has lower acquisition economics. We believe capacity is available for Penhurst, subject to onboarding slots, producer allocation and final operating confirmation. Bellhaven is not offering an exclusive or signed volume commitment at this stage.
Aneta Zuniga — Actuarial
Review note: Mature career-agency cohorts show better persistency than the independent-channel evidence currently available. The economically important distinction emerges after the three-period forecast horizon. Short-duration lapse observations are early signals only and must not be treated as mature persistency proof.
Paloma Donnelly — Operations
Planning note: A material shift requires producer onboarding, systems changes, training and service-routing work. Workforce effects may include reassignment and severance; amounts and timing remain estimates pending a detailed implementation plan. The next agency-contract cycle constrains the practical transition window.
Astrid Mortensen — Risk & conduct
Risk note: Greater reliance on Bellhaven creates concentration exposure. Producer oversight and control readiness are not yet fully evidenced for the proposed scale. Complaints and conduct monitoring are proposed controls and preliminary design items, not confirmed adverse outcomes.
Rutger Villalobos — Chief Executive
Email, 9 January 2026: Please bring a board-ready recommendation to the February strategy session. The next agency-contract cycle makes delay costly; show what is reversible and what is not.
Finance chronology note
A source date appears as “03/04/2028”; it is ambiguous between 3 April and 4 March. No conclusion depends on choosing one reading, so chronology is treated as unresolved beyond the stated FY2028 period.

Distribution Strategy Assessment
Career agency and Bellhaven Consortium independent producers

Prepared for
Decision requested
Prepared by
Rutger Villalobos and the Board
February strategy session; before the next agency-contract cycle
Finance

Recommendation at a glance
FINANCE JUDGEMENT — Approve a deliberately staged course: shift incremental new business toward Bellhaven Consortium’s independent producers, subject to gates, while retaining and funding a viable career-agency core through the next contract cycle. Do not approve an agency stand-down now.
Why: Bellhaven’s three-year acquisition economics are lower and its forecast new-business premium grows, but the material persistency comparison matures after the forecast horizon and Bellhaven capacity, terms and controls are conditional or unverified.
What this gives up: immediate full realization of the modeled distribution-cost advantage and some near-term scale of the independent channel.
What it preserves: agency service continuity, an evidence-generating comparator, and the option to change allocation before the materially difficult-to-reverse agency stand-down.
Source / status: Quantitative figures: Penhurst distribution working forecast (the “workbook”), reconciled using row-level Notes. Qualitative facts: Distribution stakeholder record (the “record”). Recommendation is Finance judgement, not a source commitment.


1 | Decision frame and source treatment
Declared frame — enterprise distribution recommendation. Finance weighs the three-year economics alongside persistency outside the horizon, execution feasibility, controls, concentration, policyholder service, workforce consequences and reversibility. This is not a recommendation based solely on the three-year forecast.
Timing
SOURCE-BACKED FACT — Rutger requests a board-ready direction for the February strategy session. The upcoming agency-contract cycle makes delay costly and constrains the practical transition window.
How Finance reconciled the workbook
Row-level Notes were considered when reconciling the workbook: FY2027 career acquisition expenditure uses the revised amount; FY2028 career field operating cost excludes the stated corporate allocation; and FY2026 support is reclassified to Bellhaven.
A separate corporate-allocation line is excluded from channel option economics in accordance with its Note. An obvious residual spreadsheet error in a legacy summary cell was disregarded; it is disconnected from valid forecast detail.
The mixed-format date “03/04/2028” is treated as unresolved between two plausible calendar readings. Finance therefore does not assert an exact FY2028 checkpoint chronology beyond the period label.
Evidence labels used throughout
Label
Meaning
SOURCE-BACKED FACT
Workbook figure or record statement, cited and qualified.
STAKEHOLDER VIEW

FINANCE JUDGEMENT

SOURCE-BACKED FACT — Bellhaven has a lower acquisition-cost-per-policy profile in every forecast period, while the career agency has lower first-year lapse in every period. Lower lapse is better. These are forecast/early indicators, not mature persistency proof.


4 | Evidence quality and limitations
Evidence
What it supports
Qualification / Finance treatment
Magda Gauthier, Career Agency
Contraction, staffing pressure and relationship continuity.
Informed agency perspective. Her view that rebuilding after stand-down would be difficult is judgement, not quantified proof.
Farida Sinclair, Bellhaven
Lower acquisition economics and potential producer capacity.
Capacity is conditional on onboarding slots, allocation and final operating confirmation; no signed or exclusive commitment.
Aneta Zuniga, Actuarial
Mature career cohorts have better persistency than available independent evidence.
The principal persistency benefit of the career agency is not fully observable inside the three-period forecast. Potentially weaker independent-channel lapse experience is likewise not fully visible inside the forecast horizon. Short-duration lapse data are not mature proof.
Paloma Donnelly, Operations
Onboarding, systems, training, service routing; reassignment/severance estimates.
Transition timing and workforce consequences require a detailed plan; amounts and timing remain estimates.
Astrid Mortensen, Risk & conduct
Bellhaven concentration, producer oversight and conduct-monitoring exposure.
Control readiness is not fully evidenced. Complaints/conduct monitoring are proposed or preliminary, not observed adverse findings.

Interpretation
FINANCE JUDGEMENT — The workbook is strong for short-horizon comparative economics once Notes are applied. Stakeholder evidence is decision-relevant but not homogeneous: Magda and Farida speak from channel interests; Aneta supplies the critical time-horizon qualification; Paloma and Astrid identify execution and control conditions. The record corroborates that a fast transition is operationally material, but does not establish a completed Bellhaven control environment or a contractual capacity commitment.


5 | Options assessed on the enterprise frame
Direction
Economics & quality
Execution / control / reversibility
Continue career-agency funding
Higher three-year distribution cost; shrinking premium and rising unit acquisition cost. Lower early lapse and mature cohorts reported as more persistent.
Preserves service continuity and agency capability. Does not capture Bellhaven’s lower unit acquisition cost; staffing pressure remains.
Shift new business toward Bellhaven independent producers
Lower unit acquisition cost; premium and policy growth; forecast contribution measure higher. Higher early lapse signal; mature downside remains unknown.
Requires transition cost, onboarding and systems work. Adds Bellhaven concentration; capacity/terms conditional; oversight readiness unproven. Agency stand-down is materially difficult to reverse.
Deliberately staged / hybrid course
Accepts some delayed cost benefit while testing the forecast economics by channel. Keeps a career comparator for lapse and later cohort evidence.
Allocation staging is reversible; preserve agency core. Gate further allocation on capacity, controls, early performance and contract-cycle review before an irreversible stand-down.

Finance conclusion
FINANCE JUDGEMENT — The staged course best fits the declared enterprise frame. It does not deny Bellhaven’s acquisition advantage; it prices the option to learn before removing a channel whose mature persistency value cannot yet be observed and whose restoration would be difficult. A full Bellhaven shift now would convert conditional capacity and incomplete control evidence into an irreversible operating decision.


6 | Recommended board decision and decision gates
FINANCE JUDGEMENT — Approve staged new-business allocation toward Bellhaven for the next cycle, retain and fund the career-agency core, and withhold approval for a stand-down. Authorize Finance, Operations and Risk to negotiate and execute only within the gates below.
Gate
Evidence required before increasing Bellhaven allocation
Decision action
Commercial / capacity
Bellhaven confirms producer allocation and onboarding slots; terms remain non-exclusive unless separately executed.
No higher allocation if capacity remains indicative or onboarding cannot support service.
Operating readiness
Paloma’s systems, training, producer onboarding and service-routing plan has dated owners; reassignment/severance estimates refreshed.
Hold allocation at pilot/staged level if transition dependencies slip.
Control readiness
Astrid validates producer oversight design, complaint/conduct monitoring and concentration reporting for the proposed scale.
No material expansion without documented control readiness.
Performance evidence
Channel-separated premium, policy volume, acquisition cost per policy and first-year lapse monitored against forecast.
Reduce/pause incremental allocation for sustained adverse variance; early lapse remains a signal, not mature persistency proof.
Contract-cycle review
Board review before the next agency-contract commitment / any stand-down decision.
Only then decide whether to retain, expand or reduce the career-agency core.

Trade-offs stated plainly
Short horizon: the recommended course accepts less immediate access to Bellhaven’s $34.7m three-year channel distribution cost versus the career agency’s $51.3m under the disclosed cost scope, and it may defer some growing independent-channel volume.
Long horizon: it preserves potential mature career-agency persistency value, while acknowledging neither channel’s mature relative outcome can be inferred from this forecast.
Operationally: it avoids immediate broad severance/reassignment and protects continuity while still requiring onboarding, systems and service-routing work.
Risk: it limits premature Bellhaven concentration and gives Risk time to evidence oversight readiness rather than treating proposed monitoring as completed control.


7 | Monitoring, review point and audit trail
Measure / owner
Cadence
Why it matters / trigger
Premium and new-policy volume by channel — Distribution / Finance
Monthly; board pack quarterly
Tests whether Bellhaven capacity and forecast production are materializing without masking career-agency contraction.
Acquisition expenditure and acquisition cost per policy by channel — Finance
Monthly
Confirms the forecast cost advantage and identifies cost creep; keep operating/support cost separately visible.
First-year lapse by channel and cohort — Actuarial
Quarterly
Early quality signal only; do not treat as mature persistency proof. Track cohorts long enough to assess the evidence gap.
Producer capacity, allocation, concentration and onboarding — Operations
Monthly during transition
Tests the conditional Bellhaven capacity claim and avoids reliance beyond confirmed allocation.
Oversight completion, complaints and conduct monitoring — Risk
Monthly; board escalation on exception
Shows proposed controls becoming evidenced operating controls; does not imply pre-existing adverse findings.

FINANCE JUDGEMENT — The meaningful review point is before the next agency-contract-cycle commitment and before any agency stand-down. This converts monitoring into a decision gate rather than open-ended observation. The most decision-material evidence gap is mature persistency: preserve a career cohort and independently monitored Bellhaven cohorts until early lapse observations can be distinguished from mature outcomes.
Traceability and limitation note
Forecast exhibits draw only from the workbook’s detail rows after row-level Notes overrides, exclusions and reclassification. Qualitative attributions are from the stakeholder record by named speaker. No residual legacy summary error was used. The unresolved mixed-format date is not used to order actions within FY2028. Finance has not assumed a signed Bellhaven commitment, completed controls, observed complaints or numerical mature-persistency outcomes.
Source / status: Workbook: Penhurst_distribution_working_forecast.xlsx, sheet “Forecast export.” Record: Distribution_stakeholder_record.docx. Prepared for Rutger Villalobos and Board.

criteria.description: 每个预测期的职业机构采购支出与适用的工作簿证据相匹配。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查整个范围内特定于渠道的支出值。

original.criterion: Career-agency acquisition expenditure for each forecast period matches the applicable workbook evidence.
original.grader_hint: Check the channel-specific expenditure values across the full horizon.

criteria.description: 每个预测期的独立生产商采购支出与适用的工作簿证据相匹配。
criteria.grader_hint: 在 Notes 中应用任何每行异常后使用源代码行。

original.criterion: Independent-producer acquisition expenditure for each forecast period matches the applicable workbook evidence.
original.grader_hint: Use the source lines after applying any per-row exception in Notes.

criteria.description: 每个预测期的职业代理现场运营成本与适用的源值相匹配。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证所有期间并将现场运营成本与采购支出区分开来。

original.criterion: Career-agency field operating cost for each forecast period matches the applicable source values.
original.grader_hint: Verify all periods and distinguish field operating cost from acquisition expenditure.

criteria.description: 每个预测期的适用独立渠道支持或监督成本与源值相匹配。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认本文不会仅仅因为不是佣金而忽略独立渠道的支持和监督成本。

original.criterion: The applicable independent-channel support or oversight cost for each forecast period matches the source values.
original.grader_hint: Confirm the paper does not omit the independent channel’s support and oversight cost merely because it is not commission.

criteria.description: 职业代理机构获取每项保单成本的衡量标准与每个显示期间适用的工作簿衡量标准一致。
criteria.grader_hint: 将报告的单位成本系列与源进行比较，而不是从不适用或被取代的行重新计算。

original.criterion: The career-agency acquisition-cost-per-policy measure agrees with the applicable workbook measure for every displayed period.
original.grader_hint: Compare the reported unit-cost series to the source rather than recalculating from an inapplicable or superseded line.

criteria.description: 每个保单的独立渠道获取成本衡量标准与每个显示期间适用的工作簿衡量标准一致。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查所有周期和正确的频道。

original.criterion: The independent-channel acquisition-cost-per-policy measure agrees with the applicable workbook measure for every displayed period.
original.grader_hint: Check all periods and the correct channel.

criteria.description: 每个时期的职业机构第一年失效衡量标准都忠实地从适用的源证据中复制出来。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查标签和数值；不接受错误标记为失效百分比的持久性百分比。

original.criterion: The career-agency first-year lapse measure for each period is faithfully reproduced from the applicable source evidence.
original.grader_hint: Check labels and values; do not accept a persistency percentage mislabeled as a lapse percentage.

criteria.description: 每个时期的独立渠道第一年失效测量均忠实地从适用的源证据中再现。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据源验证序列并确认预测值未描述为观察到的实际值。

original.criterion: The independent-channel first-year lapse measure for each period is faithfully reproduced from the applicable source evidence.
original.grader_hint: Verify the series against the source and confirm that forecast values are not described as observed actuals.

criteria.description: 任何显示的职业机构贡献衡量标准都与适用的来源定义和值相匹配。
criteria.grader_hint: 将标签和系列与工作簿进行比较；确认它并没有悄然转变为不同的盈利理念。

original.criterion: Any displayed career-agency contribution measure matches the applicable source definition and values.
original.grader_hint: Compare both label and series with the workbook; confirm it has not been silently converted into a different profit concept.

criteria.description: 任何显示的独立通道贡献度量都与适用的源定义和值相匹配。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查源定义和所有报告的期间。

original.criterion: Any displayed independent-channel contribution measure matches the applicable source definition and values.
original.grader_hint: Check the source definition and all reported periods.

criteria.description: 因离开职业介绍所而产生的过渡支出与适用的来源线和时间相匹配。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证金额或期间系列并确保未使用被取代或排除的行。

original.criterion: Transition expenditure attributed to a shift away from the career agency matches the applicable source line and timing.
original.grader_hint: Verify the amount or period series and ensure a superseded or excluded line was not used.

criteria.description: 因停止该机构而提出的任何搁浅成本金额或持续时间均与工作簿证据相符。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查滞留成本是否与遣散费或经常性分配成本混为一谈。

original.criterion: Any stranded-cost amount or duration presented for standing down the agency matches the workbook evidence.
original.grader_hint: Check that stranded cost is not conflated with severance or recurring distribution cost.

criteria.description: 评估中包含的任何职业代理能力衡量指标均与适用的源记录相匹配。
criteria.grader_hint: 将报告的度量和期间与工作簿进行比较。

original.criterion: Any career-agent capacity measure included in the assessment matches the applicable source record.
original.grader_hint: Compare the reported measure and period with the workbook.

criteria.description: 评估中包含的任何贝尔黑文独立生产商能力衡量指标均与适用的来源记录及其资格相匹配。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认定量能力声明和任何规定的条件或置信限制。

original.criterion: Any Bellhaven independent-producer capacity measure included in the assessment matches the applicable source record and its qualification.
original.grader_hint: Confirm both the quantitative capacity statement and any stated condition or confidence limitation.

criteria.description: 从第一个预测期到最后一个预测期，职业代理新业务溢价的变化方向与源序列一致。
criteria.grader_hint: 确定注释覆盖后的来源方向，并将其与散文结论进行比较。

original.criterion: The direction of change in career-agency new-business premium from the first to the final forecast period agrees with the source series.
original.grader_hint: Determine the source direction after Notes overrides and compare it with the prose conclusion.

criteria.description: 从第一个预测期到最后一个预测期，独立生产商新业务溢价的变化方向与源序列一致。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查所述趋势是否遵循适用的源值。

original.criterion: The direction of change in independent-producer new-business premium from the first to the final forecast period agrees with the source series.
original.grader_hint: Check that the stated trend follows the applicable source values.

criteria.description: 两个渠道的所述相对获取成本优势或劣势遵循适用的每保单源系列。
criteria.evidence: 执行摘要或单位经济分析
criteria.grader_hint: 结论必须与各个时期的单位成本证据一致，并披露关系发生变化的任何时期。

original.criterion: The stated relative acquisition-cost advantage or disadvantage of the two channels follows the applicable per-policy source series.
original.evidence: Executive summary or unit economics analysis
original.grader_hint: The conclusion must agree with the period-by-period unit-cost evidence and disclose any period in which the relationship changes.

criteria.description: 两个渠道的第一年相对失效表现遵循适用的来源证据。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认较低的失误被解释为更好，并且预测和观察到的证据没有混为一谈。

original.criterion: The stated relative first-year lapse performance of the two channels follows the applicable source evidence.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that lower lapse is interpreted as better and that projected and observed evidence are not conflated.

criteria.description: 任何规定的累计三期新业务保费等于相关期权的适用期间价值之和，在该总和的 ±0.1% 范围内。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据 Notes 覆盖后选择的源值重新计算。如果没有显示累积保费，则无法赚取此项目。

original.criterion: Any stated cumulative three-period new-business premium equals the sum of the applicable period values for the relevant option, within ±0.1% of that sum.
original.grader_hint: Recalculate from the source values selected after Notes overrides. If no cumulative premium is shown, this item is not earned.

criteria.description: 任何规定的累积三期分配成本等于评估中所述的成本组成部分的总和，且在该总和的 ±0.1% 范围内。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用评估公开的成本范围和适用的源行重新计算；验证内部一致性。

original.criterion: Any stated cumulative three-period distribution cost equals the sum of the cost components the assessment says it includes, within ±0.1% of that sum.
original.grader_hint: Recalculate using the assessment’s disclosed cost scope and applicable source rows; verify internal consistency.

criteria.description: 重大的周期变化是使用来源支持的驱动因素来解释的，而不是仅仅重述为变动。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找与生产、人员配置、佣金、过渡或监督假设等来源证据相关的解释。

original.criterion: Material period-to-period changes are explained using source-supported drivers rather than merely restated as movements.
original.grader_hint: Look for explanations linked to source evidence such as production, staffing, commission, transition or oversight assumptions.

criteria.description: 玛格达·高蒂尔（Magda Gauthier）关于职业机构收缩或人员压力的证据得到了准确的体现。
criteria.grader_hint: 将声明与 Magda 的来源条目进行比较，并保持其确定性程度。

original.criterion: Magda Gauthier’s evidence about career-agency contraction or staffing pressure is represented accurately.
original.grader_hint: Compare the statement with Magda’s source entry and preserve its degree of certainty.

criteria.description: Magda Gauthier 关于投保人服务或关系连续性的证据得到了准确的体现。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查评估是否遗漏了这一点，也没有将其扩展到玛格达所说的范围之外。

original.criterion: Magda Gauthier’s evidence about policyholder service or relationship continuity is represented accurately.
original.grader_hint: Check that the assessment neither omits the point nor expands it beyond what Magda states.

criteria.description: 玛格达·高蒂尔 (Magda Gauthier) 关于重建该机构困难的声明包含在其来源资格中。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证利益相关者的判断没有以量化的确定性的形式呈现。

original.criterion: Magda Gauthier’s statement concerning the difficulty of rebuilding the agency is included with its source qualification.
original.grader_hint: Verify that stakeholder judgement is not presented as a quantified certainty.

criteria.description: Farida Sinclair 对 Bellhaven 收购经济学的描述得到了准确的体现。
criteria.grader_hint: 将该声明与法里达的记录以及经济附带的任何条件进行比较。

original.criterion: Farida Sinclair’s description of Bellhaven’s acquisition economics is represented accurately.
original.grader_hint: Compare the statement with Farida’s record and any conditions attached to the economics.

criteria.description: 法里达·辛克莱 (Farida Sinclair) 关于可用生产者产能的声明已报告，并附有适用的限制或依赖性。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果来源提出有条件，则能力主张不得作为无条件提出。

original.criterion: Farida Sinclair’s statement about available producer capacity is reported with the applicable limitation or dependency.
original.grader_hint: The capacity claim must not be presented as unconditional if the source makes it conditional.

criteria.description: 法里达·辛克莱关于合同承诺或非排他性的声明得到了准确的体现。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查该文件是否区分了声明的商业立场和签署的承诺。

original.criterion: Farida Sinclair’s statement about contractual commitment or non-exclusivity is represented accurately.
original.grader_hint: Check that the paper distinguishes a stated commercial position from a signed commitment.

criteria.description: Aneta Zuniga 警告称，成熟的持久性证据超出了预测范围。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认清楚地传达了时间范围不匹配。

original.criterion: Aneta Zuniga’s warning that mature persistency evidence falls outside the forecast horizon is included.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that the time-horizon mismatch is clearly conveyed.

criteria.description: 阿内塔·祖尼加（Aneta Zuniga）关于不要将短期失效观察视为成熟的持久性证据的警告得到了准确的体现。
criteria.grader_hint: 评估应保留早期失效信号和成熟队列结果之间的区别。

original.criterion: Aneta Zuniga’s caution against treating short-duration lapse observations as mature persistency proof is represented accurately.
original.grader_hint: The assessment should preserve the distinction between early lapse signals and mature cohort outcomes.

criteria.description: 阿内塔·祖尼加（Aneta Zuniga）关于成熟职业代理业务相对持久性的证据包括在没有未经支持的推断的情况下。
criteria.grader_hint: 与利益相关者记录进行比较，确保论文不会制造超出来源的预测值。

original.criterion: Aneta Zuniga’s evidence about the relative persistency of mature career-agency business is included without unsupported extrapolation.
original.grader_hint: Compare with the stakeholder record and ensure the paper does not manufacture a forecast value beyond the source.

criteria.description: 帕洛玛·唐纳利 (Paloma Donnelly) 的过渡时间证据得到了准确的体现。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认时间和依赖性与 Paloma 的注释相符。

original.criterion: Paloma Donnelly’s transition-timing evidence is represented accurately.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that timing and dependencies match Paloma’s notes.

criteria.description: 帕洛玛·唐纳利 (Paloma Donnelly) 关于遣散费、重新分配或劳动力后果的证据也包括在内。
criteria.grader_hint: 评估可以进行总结，但必须保留哪些后果是预期的，哪些仍是估计的。

original.criterion: Paloma Donnelly’s evidence concerning severance, reassignment or workforce consequences is included.
original.grader_hint: The assessment may summarize, but it must preserve which consequences are expected and which remain estimates.

criteria.description: 其中包括帕洛玛·唐纳利 (Paloma Donnelly) 关于独立渠道转变的系统或入职工作的证据。
criteria.grader_hint: 与操作源条目进行比较。

original.criterion: Paloma Donnelly’s evidence concerning systems or onboarding work for an independent-channel shift is included.
original.grader_hint: Compare with the operations source entry.

criteria.description: 阿斯特丽德·莫滕森（Astrid Mortensen）对更加依赖贝尔黑文的集中风险担忧也包括在内。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认问题与建议的分发方向有关。

original.criterion: Astrid Mortensen’s concentration-risk concern regarding greater reliance on Bellhaven is included.
original.grader_hint: Confirm the issue is connected to the proposed distribution direction.

criteria.description: 阿斯特丽德·莫滕森 (Astrid Mortensen) 对生产者监督或控制准备情况的担忧得到了准确的体现。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查现有控制、计划控制和未经验证的准备情况是否未混为一谈。

original.criterion: Astrid Mortensen’s concern about producer oversight or control readiness is represented accurately.
original.grader_hint: Check that existing controls, planned controls and unverified readiness are not conflated.

criteria.description: 阿斯特丽德·莫滕森 (Astrid Mortensen) 有关投诉、行为或监控暴露的证据包含在正确的状态中。
criteria.grader_hint: 保留来源是否描述了观察到的结果、关注点或拟议的监测措施。

original.criterion: Astrid Mortensen’s evidence about complaints, conduct or monitoring exposure is included with the correct status.
original.grader_hint: Preserve whether the source describes observed results, a concern or a proposed monitoring measure.

criteria.description: 该评估协调了利益相关者的主张和职能观点，而不是将每项声明都视为同等客观。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻求对角色、兴趣、信心和佐证的认可，而不要仅仅因为证据是定性的而忽视证据。

original.criterion: The assessment reconciles stakeholder advocacy and functional perspective rather than treating every statement as equally objective.
original.grader_hint: Look for recognition of roles, interests, confidence and corroboration without dismissing evidence solely because it is qualitative.

criteria.description: 评估确定利益相关者记录中至少一项暂定、有条件或未经确认的重大陈述。
criteria.evidence: 证据登记、限制或来源注释
criteria.grader_hint: 将所选语句与其源措辞进行比较，并确认其状态已准确表征。

original.criterion: The assessment identifies at least one material statement in the stakeholder record that is tentative, conditional or unconfirmed.
original.evidence: Evidence register, limitations or source notes
original.grader_hint: Compare the selected statement with its source wording and confirm its status is accurately characterized.

criteria.description: 指定利益相关者得出的任何定量或定性结论都不会与该利益相关者的来源条目存在实质性矛盾。
criteria.grader_hint: 追踪利益相关者记录的每个命名归因；轻微的释义是可以接受的，颠倒或不合理的强化则不可以。

original.criterion: No quantitative or qualitative conclusion attributed to a named stakeholder materially contradicts that stakeholder’s source entry.
original.grader_hint: Trace each named attribution to the stakeholder record; minor paraphrase is acceptable, reversal or unjustified strengthening is not.

criteria.description: 工作簿中的残差公式误差单元格不用作预测值、总计、趋势或建议输入。
criteria.grader_hint: 找到种子公式错误，然后验证评估中不存在其显示或缓存的结果，并且不会影响报告的总数。

original.criterion: The residual formula-error cell in the workbook is not used as a forecast value, total, trend or recommendation input.
original.grader_hint: Locate the seeded formula error, then verify that its displayed or cached result is absent from the assessment and has not influenced reported totals.

criteria.description: 评估显示，一个明显的残余电子表格错误被忽略。
criteria.grader_hint: 确切的单元格地址是可选的，但问题和处理必须是审阅者可以理解的。

original.criterion: The assessment discloses that an obvious residual spreadsheet error was disregarded.
original.grader_hint: The exact cell address is optional, but the issue and treatment must be understandable to a reviewer.

criteria.description: 注释文本取代主列值的每个源行都使用取代值或指令表示。
criteria.grader_hint: 识别工作簿中的所有覆盖注释，并通过评估跟踪每个受影响的事实。

original.criterion: Every source row whose Notes text supersedes a main-column value is represented using the superseding value or instruction.
original.grader_hint: Identify all override notes in the workbook and trace each affected fact through the assessment.

criteria.description: 注释文本排除或重新分类该行的每个源行将根据评估中的异常进行处理。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据报告的比较检查注释中的每个排除或渠道/范围重新分类。

original.criterion: Every source row whose Notes text excludes or reclassifies the row is treated according to that exception in the assessment.
original.grader_hint: Check each exclusion or channel/scope reclassification in Notes against the reported comparison.

criteria.description: 评估指出，在协调工作簿时考虑了行级注释。
criteria.evidence: 基础、来源质量或脚注部分
criteria.grader_hint: 如果明确说明 Notes 可以更改明显的主栏条目，则等效措辞是可以接受的。

original.criterion: The assessment states that row-level Notes were considered when reconciling the workbook.
original.grader_hint: Equivalent wording is acceptable if it makes clear that Notes can alter the apparent main-column entry.

criteria.description: 模棱两可的混合格式日期以保守的、专业的方式解释。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受合理的日历解释，或将事件日期视为未解决，前提是该选择与明确的来源年表不矛盾。

original.criterion: The ambiguous mixed-format date is interpreted in a conservative, professionally defensible way.
original.grader_hint: Accept either plausible calendar interpretation, or treating the event date as unresolved, provided the choice does not contradict unambiguous source chronology.

criteria.description: 明确公开了对不明确的混合格式日期所选择的处理方式，包括对时间顺序产生的任何限制。
criteria.grader_hint: 审阅者必须能够辨别日期是如何被读取的，或者是故意未解决的。

original.criterion: The chosen treatment of the ambiguous mixed-format date is explicitly disclosed, including any resulting limitation on chronology.
original.grader_hint: A reviewer must be able to tell how the date was read or that it was deliberately left unresolved.

criteria.description: 该评估比较了经济性、持久性、执行可行性、控制风险和可逆性等方面的选择。
criteria.grader_hint: 每个标准必须对比较产生重大影响；仅仅列出标题是不够的。

original.criterion: The assessment compares the options across economics, persistency, execution feasibility, control risk and reversibility.
original.grader_hint: Each criterion must materially affect the comparison; a bare list of headings is insufficient.

criteria.description: 该建议逻辑上遵循评估声明的决策框架和提供的证据。
criteria.grader_hint: 不要对方向本身进行评分。评估所选择的方向是否站得住脚并与规定的框架一致。

original.criterion: The recommendation follows logically from the assessment’s declared decision frame and the evidence presented.
original.grader_hint: Do not grade the direction itself. Grade whether the chosen direction is defensible and consistent with the stated frame.

criteria.description: 该建议解释了彭赫斯特接受的短期经济效益或成本。
criteria.grader_hint: 解释必须针对来源支持成本和新业务比较。

original.criterion: The recommendation explains what short-horizon economic benefit or cost Penhurst accepts.
original.grader_hint: The explanation must be specific to the source-backed cost and new-business comparison.

criteria.description: 该建议解释了彭赫斯特可能放弃的长期持续价值或风险。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找超出预测范围和适当不确定性的明确后果。

original.criterion: The recommendation explains what long-horizon persistency value or risk Penhurst may give up.
original.grader_hint: Look for an explicit consequence beyond the forecast horizon and appropriate uncertainty.

criteria.description: 该建议解释了所选方向的运营或劳动力后果。
criteria.grader_hint: 结果必须以帕洛玛或玛格达的证据为基础。

original.criterion: The recommendation explains the operational or workforce consequence of the selected direction.
original.grader_hint: The consequence must be grounded in Paloma’s or Magda’s evidence.

criteria.description: 该建议解释了所选方向的集中、监督或行为风险后果。
criteria.grader_hint: 后果必须与阿斯特丽德的证据和贝尔黑文的依赖程度挂钩。

original.criterion: The recommendation explains the concentration, oversight or conduct-risk consequence of the selected direction.
original.grader_hint: The consequence must be tied to Astrid’s evidence and the degree of Bellhaven reliance.

criteria.description: 该评估将可逆的分阶段选择与实质上不可逆转的撤销该机构的决定区分开来。
criteria.evidence: 决策设计或可逆性部分
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找具体的差异化，而不是笼统地声明所有策略都存在风险。

original.criterion: The assessment distinguishes reversible staging choices from the materially irreversible decision to stand down the agency.
original.grader_hint: Look for concrete differentiation rather than a generic statement that all strategy carries risk.

criteria.description: 如果推荐分阶段课程，其目的、决策门限和保留选项是明确的；如果推荐另一门课程，评估会解释分期不足的原因。
criteria.grader_hint: 应用与提交的建议相匹配的分支。无论哪种情况，论文都必须实质性地解决分期问题。

original.criterion: If a staged course is recommended, its purpose, decision gates and preserved options are clear; if another course is recommended, the assessment explains why staging is insufficient.
original.grader_hint: Apply the branch matching the submitted recommendation. The paper must address staging substantively in either case.

criteria.description: 该评估确定了预测范围造成的最具决策实质性的证据差距。
criteria.grader_hint: 这种差距应该涉及成熟的持久性或失败结果，而不是对更多数据的一般要求。

original.criterion: The assessment identifies the most decision-material evidence gap created by the forecast horizon.
original.grader_hint: The gap should concern mature persistency or lapse outcomes, not a generic request for more data.

criteria.description: 该评估确定了在做出不可逆转的承诺之前保存或收集证据的实用方法。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受队列监控、控制分配、分阶段容量测试或其他源一致的方法。

original.criterion: The assessment identifies a practical way to preserve or gather evidence before an irreversible commitment.
original.grader_hint: Accept cohort monitoring, controlled allocation, staged capacity testing or another source-consistent approach.

criteria.description: 监控计划包括新业务量或优质绩效，并具有明确的渠道区分。
criteria.grader_hint: 该措施必须允许通过渠道评估所选方向的性能。

original.criterion: The monitoring plan includes new-business volume or premium performance with a clear channel distinction.
original.grader_hint: The measure must allow performance of the chosen direction to be assessed by channel.

criteria.description: 监控计划包括购置成本或每策略性能成本。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受总成本和单位成本，或者明确与决策相关的单位成本衡量标准。

original.criterion: The monitoring plan includes acquisition cost or cost-per-policy performance.
original.grader_hint: Accept either total and unit cost together or a clearly decision-relevant unit-cost measure.

criteria.description: 监测计划包括早期失效或持久性指标，同时警告它们不是成熟的队列证明。
criteria.grader_hint: 指标和成熟度警告都必须存在。

original.criterion: The monitoring plan includes early lapse or persistency indicators while warning that they are not mature cohort proof.
original.grader_hint: Both the indicator and the maturity caveat must be present.

criteria.description: 监测计划包括 Bellhaven 产能、集中度或生产者监督证据。
criteria.grader_hint: 至少需要一项与独立渠道可行性或控制风险相关的具体措施。

original.criterion: The monitoring plan includes Bellhaven capacity, concentration or producer-oversight evidence.
original.grader_hint: At least one concrete measure tied to independent-channel feasibility or control risk is required.

criteria.description: 监控计划分配了一个与合同周期决策相关的有意义的审查点，而不是让监控处于开放式状态。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受源一致的里程碑、门限或节奏；如果不明确的源日期影响它，则不需要具体日期。

original.criterion: The monitoring plan assigns a meaningful review point connected to the contract-cycle decision rather than leaving monitoring open-ended.
original.grader_hint: Accept a source-consistent milestone, gate or cadence; do not require a specific date if the ambiguous source date affects it.

criteria.description: 该评估为审阅者提供了足够的来源可追溯性，以将材料声明和数据连接到工作簿或利益相关者记录。
criteria.evidence: 脚注、来源标签、附录或展览注释
criteria.grader_hint: 正式的引用风格是不必要的，但材料声明必须是可审计的，而无需猜测其来源。

original.criterion: The assessment provides sufficient source traceability for a reviewer to connect material claims and figures to the workbook or stakeholder record.
original.evidence: Footnotes, source labels, appendix or exhibit notes
original.grader_hint: Formal citation style is unnecessary, but material claims must be auditable without guessing their source.

criteria.description: 职业中介、独立制片人、贝尔黑文联盟、失效、持久性、收购支出和运营成本等术语的使用是一致的。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查标签是否在展品和散文之间切换含义。

original.criterion: Terminology for career agency, independent producers, Bellhaven Consortium, lapse, persistency, acquisition expenditure and operating cost is used consistently.
original.grader_hint: Check that labels do not switch meanings between exhibits and prose.

criteria.description: 执行摘要、选项说明和最终建议与所选方向及其主要理由一致。
criteria.grader_hint: 追踪所有三个地点的决策声明和主要理由。

original.criterion: The executive summary, option exhibits and final recommendation agree on the selected direction and its principal rationale.
original.grader_hint: Trace the decision statement and major rationale across all three locations.

criteria.description: 交付的文档不包含可见的#REF!、#DIV/0!或#VALUE！错误字符串。
criteria.evidence: DOCX 正文、表格、页眉、页脚和嵌入预览
criteria.grader_hint: 搜索提取的文本并检查渲染的表格或链接对象预览中的所有三个错误标记。

original.criterion: The delivered document contains no visible #REF!, #DIV/0! or #VALUE! error strings.
original.evidence: DOCX body, tables, headers, footers and embedded previews
original.grader_hint: Search extracted text and inspect rendered tables or linked-object previews for all three error tokens.

criteria.description: 最终的论文简洁、易读且可供决策使用，包含重要证据，并附有次要的来源细节。
criteria.grader_hint: 评估董事会成员是否可以在不浏览源文件的情况下理解选择、证据质量、权衡和所需的决策。

original.criterion: The final paper is concise, legible and decision-usable, with material evidence included and minor source detail subordinated.
original.grader_hint: Assess whether a board member could understand the choice, evidence quality, tradeoffs and required decision without working through the source files.

spec.professional_context: Cosima Vandeleur is Penhurst Mutual Life’s finance manager and is preparing the distribution decision for chief executive Rutger Villalobos ahead of the insurer’s February strategy session. The decision concerns whether to continue funding the career agency or move new business toward Bellhaven Consortium’s independent producers before the next agency-contract cycle.
difficulty_sources: Reconciling row-level narrative exceptions against apparent spreadsheet values
Ignoring an isolated legacy formula error without losing valid surrounding evidence
Handling a materially ambiguous mixed-format date conservatively
Separating confirmed facts, stakeholder advocacy, conditions and finance judgement
Balancing short-horizon acquisition economics against persistency evidence outside the forecast horizon
Making a recommendation where reversibility and evidence maturity point in competing directions

Penhurst_distribution_working_forecast.x.role: Provide the complete quantitative record used in the assessment.
semantic_content: Three consecutive forecast periods for the career-agency and independent-producer options.

For each channel and period, provide new-business premium, new-policy count, acquisition expenditure, acquisition cost per policy, relevant operating or oversight cost, first-year lapse and a consistently defined contribution measure.
Provide career-agent capacity and Bellhaven producer-capacity evidence, transition expenditure, stranded cost and the timing of those costs.

Make the career-agency series show contraction over the horizon and make independent distribution show a lower acquisition-cost profile, while leaving enough competing evidence that a broader enterprise recommendation is not mechanically determined by those economics.
Use internally coherent values: ordinary source figures and displayed ratios should reconcile except where a Notes exception explicitly changes the applicable fact.

Include an ordinary free-text Notes column on the forecast detail. Seed several genuine per-row exceptions: one note supersedes a main-column amount with a revised amount, one excludes a line from the option comparison because it is a corporate allocation, and one reclassifies a line to the other distribution channel. The gold uses the Notes instruction in every case.

Include one residual formula error from a prior analyst in a legacy summary cell. It must be visibly or extractably erroneous, disconnected from the valid detail and unnecessary for deriving any correct result. The gold ignores it and never propagates its cached or displayed content.

Include one date field that otherwise contains clean event or assumption dates but mixes a written-month representation with a short all-numeric representation. Make one numeric date genuinely ambiguous between day-first and month-first readings. Do not add a data dictionary or surrounding wording that resolves it.
The ambiguous date may affect the exact ordering of a transition checkpoint but must not change the underlying period figures or make the task unsolvable under either reasonable interpretation.
Include no duplicate records, hidden values, unit mismatch, merged-data obstruction, inconsistent identifiers, unexplained blanks, floating-point noise or other standard layout defects.
gold_rules: All channel-period values are copied from the applicable source row after applying Notes overrides.
Any cumulative metric is the sum of applicable period values under the assessment’s disclosed scope.
Any trend statement follows the first-to-final movement in the applicable series.
The legacy error cell contributes nothing to any value, total, trend or recommendation.
Excluded corporate allocation does not enter option economics; the reclassified row belongs only to the channel named in Notes.
Both plausible readings of the ambiguous short date are acceptable if disclosed and if chronology is not overstated.

Distribution_stakeholder_record.docx.role: Provide qualitative evidence, confidence qualifications and consequences outside the quantitative horizon.
semantic_content: Present a realistic compilation of emails, messages and interview notes rather than a purpose-built policy or answer key.

Include Magda Gauthier’s career-agency perspective: agency contraction or staffing pressure, policyholder-service continuity, and her view that a stood-down agency could not be readily rebuilt. Mark the rebuilding statement as informed judgement rather than quantified proof.

Include Farida Sinclair’s Bellhaven perspective: lower acquisition economics, available producer capacity subject to onboarding or allocation conditions, and a commercial position that is not a signed or exclusive commitment.

Include Aneta Zuniga’s actuarial perspective: mature career-agency cohorts exhibit better persistency than available independent-channel evidence, the economically important distinction emerges after the forecast horizon, and short-duration lapse observations must not be represented as mature persistency proof. Do not provide unsupported beyond-horizon forecast values.

Include Paloma Donnelly’s operations perspective: transition timing, workforce consequences, severance or reassignment considerations, and systems or producer-onboarding work required for a material shift.

Include Astrid Mortensen’s oversight perspective: concentration risk from heavier Bellhaven reliance, producer-control readiness that is not yet fully evidenced, and complaints or conduct monitoring that is proposed or preliminary rather than a confirmed adverse outcome.
Include the next contract-cycle and February strategy-session timing in ordinary stakeholder correspondence.

Ensure some statements are corroborated across roles while others are clearly advocacy, estimate, condition or open question. Preserve clear status language so the solver can distinguish facts from tentative claims.
Do not introduce jurisdiction-specific law, external market facts or any information requiring internet research.
Use clean text, complete paragraphs and consistent role identification. Do not seed any layout defect beyond the mixed date representation located in the workbook.
gold_rules: Attributed statements must preserve the speaker, substance and degree of certainty.
Conditional Bellhaven capacity is not a guaranteed commitment.
Proposed controls and complaint monitoring are not represented as completed controls or observed adverse findings.
Mature persistency evidence supports a long-horizon tradeoff but does not justify invented numerical projections.
Standing down the agency is treated as materially less reversible than staging new-business allocation.

intended_transformation: Create a new board-oriented DOCX that faithfully reshapes the workbook and stakeholder record into a three-period option comparison, evidence-quality assessment and recommendation.
Reconcile the workbook’s applicable rows using the row-level Notes while disregarding the isolated legacy formula error.
Synthesize stakeholder evidence without converting opinions, conditions or proposals into confirmed facts.
Choose explicitly between a narrow three-period economics frame and a broader enterprise decision frame. Either may support the final direction if consistently applied.
Explain material changes, compare economic and non-economic criteria, identify reversibility asymmetry and state what the chosen direction sacrifices.
Include monitoring or decision gates that address volume, cost, early lapse signals, mature persistency limitations and independent-channel capacity or oversight.
acceptable_verdicts: Continue funding the career agency if the broader frame gives decisive weight to irreversibility and unobserved mature persistency, provided the assessment acknowledges the short-horizon cost disadvantage.

Shift new business toward Bellhaven if the declared frame emphasizes three-period economics and execution evidence, provided the assessment acknowledges concentration, control, lapse and irreversibility risks.
Recommend a staged allocation if it is justified as preserving option value while gathering evidence, with meaningful gates rather than indefinite delay.
unacceptable_behaviors: Using the residual formula-error cell as evidence.
Ignoring or selectively applying Notes overrides.
Inventing mature persistency forecasts, contractual commitments, completed controls or observed complaints.
Treating early lapse projections as mature persistency proof.
Leaving the decision frame implicit while switching between narrow and broad criteria.
Claiming precise chronology from the ambiguous short date without disclosing an interpretation.

deliverables.description: Board-ready presentation-style three-year distribution strategy forecast and compliance assessment, including a justified direction, tradeoffs, limitations and monitoring needs.
constraints: Place the file at the top level of the working directory.
Do not exceed fourteen rendered pages.
Present source-backed facts separately from finance judgement.
Make the chosen decision frame and any material source interpretation explicit.
Do not represent tentative statements as confirmed commitments.

original_instruction:
You are the finance manager supporting Penhurst Mutual Life’s enterprise distribution review. Rutger Villalobos needs a board-ready assessment for the February strategy session because the next agency-contract cycle will make delay costly: the career agency is shrinking and expensive inside the planning window, while Bellhaven Consortium offers cheaper acquisition but may bring weaker lapse experience that will not be fully visible for several years. The prior analyst’s three-year figures and option assumptions are in `Penhurst_distribution_working_forecast.xlsx`, and the relevant emails, interview notes and stakeholder qualifications are collected in `Distribution_stakeholder_record.docx`. Prepare `Penhurst_distribution_assessment.docx` as a concise presentation-style paper of no more than fourteen pages for Rutger and the board. It should present the three-year new-business and distribution-cost comparison, assess the quality and limitations of the evidence, identify material changes over the forecast periods, and recommend whether Penhurst should keep funding the career agency, shift new business to Bellhaven’s independent producers, or take a deliberately staged course. State plainly what the recommended direction gives up, what is reversible, what is not, and what evidence would need to be monitored after the decision. The paper must distinguish source-backed facts from finance’s judgement and must not turn tentative stakeholder comments into commitments. Be explicit about whether your conclusion is limited to the three-year economics or is an enterprise distribution recommendation that also weighs consequences outside the forecast horizon; either reading is acceptable if it is applied consistently and supports the decision being asked of the board. Resolve the untidy source material conservatively, disclose any interpretation that could affect the conclusion, and do not reproduce an obvious spreadsheet error as if it were evidence. Write the completed file into the top level of the working directory using exactly the filename `Penhurst_distribution_assessment.docx`.

---

The files referred to above are in `references/`:

- `references/Penhurst_distribution_working_forecast.xlsx` — Prior analyst’s three-period channel forecast, option assumptions, cost components, operating measures and row-level notes.
- `references/Distribution_stakeholder_record.docx` — Collected emails, messages and interview notes concerning agency economics, independent-producer terms, persistency, transition feasibility, controls and decision timing.

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `Penhurst_distribution_assessment.docx` — Board-ready presentation-style three-year distribution strategy forecast and compliance assessment, including a justified direction, tradeoffs, limitations and monitoring needs. (Place the file at the top level of the working directory.; Use exactly the required filename.; Do not exceed fourteen rendered pages.; Present source-backed facts separately from finance judgement.; Make the chosen decision frame and any material source interpretation explicit.; Do not represent tentative statements as confirmed commitments.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.
